verdict.rationale: Bento explicitly claims to tie sales and recurring revenue back to the email or flow that preceded them (bento-docs-6). The docs back the data plumbing: $purchase events carry an amount (bento-docs-39), and unique events let Bento count revenue without double-counting (bento-docs-48). The attribution reporting itself is described only in a homepage marketing line, missing for 10: documentation of the attribution model and reports (window, per-email vs per-flow breakdown), explicit signup/conversion attribution beyond revenue, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
